notes: 30 warmup frames; audio off; ordinary simulation and rendering, no frame limiter.
perf-indoor-before-warm and after-warm use 600 measured frames and pre-optimization depth draws.

perf-final-before disables IBL/contact; perf-final-after enables both after frustum culling and texture-free depth draws. Both request --camera; motel did not display an assigned inset in the captured frame.
perf-shipped-default uses HDR lighting with contact disabled. These performance samples precede the final sky sampler-binding correction; no post-correction speed claim is made.
This is a busy interactive workstation. High variance persists with effects off. Results are not a stable FPS guarantee or evidence of a speedup.
Original concurrent/cold 300-frame before/after runs are excluded.
GPU behavior and world immutability are checked separately; this does not benchmark training.
